tips.text: Bring Titania, or group with one; Razorwing flight makes grabbing Remnants trivial and Remnants are your fragment income.
Run Steel Path; it pays more fragments and its lobbies actually fill.
Sweep the Void tunnel every transition so you reach 50 Remnants before the next crystal.
Put Animal Instinct on a companion or use Loot Radar to mark Remnants on the minimap, and listen for the spawn cue.
Keep killing; over-CCing the map lowers Remnant spawns, so in a group let one or two hold while the rest collect.
Solo, park Titania's Lantern on the enemy spawns to keep aggro off the crystal while you fly around.
Decide as a group before round 3 ends whether to continue; losing the crystal on round 4 pays nothing, even for earlier rounds.
Stay past round 4 into rounds 5 to 7 for more Rotation A and B rolls in the same run.
Farm Corufell alongside Citrine and the Tyana Pass arcanes in one run; they share fragments.
Hope the blueprint drops naturally; at 500 Rania it is the most expensive piece to buy.
Expect Corpus-side pickups to sit offset from their hitbox, so you may have to guess where one really is.
Players vote this farm among the worst for its timer-locked length, not its difficulty, yet call the weapon strong at every level.
